lebanon-2010.notes: Source 1: crawl of the LAU computer science site holds only the 2009 LCPC page and a contests page that lists the second LCPC (June 2010) as a future event; likely belongs to lebanon-2009.

sources.evidence: The only page of the Lebanese contest in the crawl announces the first Lebanese Collegiate Programming Contest on 2-3 July 2009 (Spring 2009), the seed is a redirect stub, and the contests page lists the second contest for June 2010 only as a future event.
